instruction: LPUSH an element to a Redis list
LRANGE elements from a Redis list
LLEN to get Redis list length
SADD to add members to a Redis set
SMEMBERS to retrieve all Redis set members
SISMEMBER check presence in Redis set
ZADD to add members to a Redis sorted set
ZRANGE to retrieve sorted set by rank
ZREVRANGE to retrieve sorted set descending
ZRANK to get rank in sorted set
INCR to atomically increment a Redis counter
INCRBY to increment by specific amount
MSET multiple keys at once
output: redis-cli MSET key1 value1 key2 value2 key3 value3

instruction: MGET multiple keys at once
EVAL a Lua script in Redis
output: redis-cli EVAL 'return redis.call("SET", KEYS[1], ARGV[1])' 1 mykey myvalue

instruction: PUBLISH a message to a Redis channel
SUBSCRIBE to a Redis channel (blocking)
Redis CLUSTER INFO
Redis CLUSTER ADDSLOTS to assign hash slots
Redis CLUSTER MEET to join a node
Redis CLUSTER FORGET to remove a node
Redis CLUSTER REPLICATE to set as replica
Redis CLUSTER FAILOVER to force manual failover
Redis CLUSTER NODES to view cluster topology
Redis CLUSTER KEYSLOT to find slot for a key
